subject: ParallelR speed enhancement under Windows OS

messages.author: 851baabb324f1dd1
messages.subject: ParallelR speed enhancement under Windows OS
parts: Why should I use ParallelR when RRO is already leveraging the multi-core processing? Would I still get relevant speed increase by using ParallelR over RRO under Windows OS?

messages.author: 88275a537c4bd7d2
messages.subject: Re: [RRO] ParallelR speed enhancement under Windows OS
parts:
Only certain R functions take advantage of the multi-core capabilities of multi-threaded libraries. Using ParallelR is a way to take advantage of multiple cores for everything else (as long as you can express the problem as a loop). The "birthday" example from the webinar today is a good example: even though it was running on RRO, you still got a performance improvement by running the loop through foreach/doMC.

(If you missed the webinar, the replay will be available soon from: http://www.revolutionanalytics.com/webinars/introducing-revolution-r-open-enhanced-open-source-r-distribution-revolution-analytics )
